blocked_on: note:Full primitive accounting, symmetric calibration and complete cold one-target replay remain unimplemented and unrun. High-level proxy counts are not a calibrated cost.
question: Do any apparent IC stage or pipeline savings survive complete symmetric pricing of construction, solver, projection, verification and linear algebra?
decision_value: A lower verified cost than the frozen best IC baseline is an IC improvement within this workload. Beating rho is a separate test. An unexplained sensitivity reversal or missing material cost blocks a complete-cost claim.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU and 4 GiB per arm, 120 seconds per one-target cell, checkpoint after each arm/target. Full-grid runtime remains unestimated; pilot measurements are required before scheduling it. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.
